notes: Corrected evaluation protocol: explicit permitted tool sequences, one bounded revision and controlled fault prefixes. V1 FAIL retained. Same 68 development/validation requests, 17 NEW reserved requests never executed before freezing this version. Product fixes since v1 holdout come only from documented development create-2: cardinal numbers are not topic names; derived outputs are not mandatory inputs. No model/system prompt was tuned on holdout outcomes.
semanticThresholds: Measure baseline per split; freeze thresholds after development measurement before optimization.
